answer: Reef-Locked Answer Vault: each identity must submit a unique, non-reusable answer to a verifier-issued challenge, derived from a private key sealed in a hardware vault; the answer is checked against a one-time nullifier so replays fail. The ivory ledger stores only nullifiers, not identities. An attacker pays full hardware cost plus a fresh challenge response per identity, so mass issuance requires mass unique hardware, making duplication economically unviable.
